entities.summary: Central University of Gujarat is a Public Central Research University in Kundhela Village, Dabhoi Taluka, Vadodara, Gujarat, India, offering courses at undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral levels. Prof. Atanu Bhattacharya is In-Charge Vice-Chancellor of Central University of Gujarat.
